name: submit_post_call_summary
description: Generate a summary of the call and submit it to Tavus. Using the full transcript and any perception data, generate a summary of the call, including any incidents that occurred and a subjective score of how relaxed the user was before, during, and after the session.

summary.description: A 2-4 sentence summary of the call, including any incidents that occurred.

relaxation_score_pre.description: A subjective score of how relaxed the user was before the session.

relaxation_score_during.description: A subjective score of how relaxed the user was during the session.

relaxation_score_post.description: A subjective score of how relaxed the user was after the session.

incidents.description: A structured list of any incidents that occurred during the call.
